Allocation/outputreset/prefixcapture/fulltimedfinalcapture/FASTAprint/taggeddeterministicfullstagereplay/checkoutside. Fullpipeline warmupoutsideall5trials.
confounds: One five-trial block per model, ordered execution; no causal ranking or temporal stability claim.
CPU sort, representative transfers/control, data transfers and full GPU pipeline included; private DP payload may compile differently, no measured register/local-memory/occupancy counters.
Source host correction explicitly changes kmer inventory, final FASTA unchanged on these named fixtures.
KA/JACC inherit corrected CUDAjl body and common host harness; marginal ordered effort, not independent generation.
Untimed deterministic stage replay follows timed final capture and is labeled replay, not actual timed intermediate observations.

RQ4.motif: Irregular read filtering plus private-array dynamic programming and host-controlled representative clustering
RQ4.features: 14 entrypoints, 120 timed launches, source 512B block-filter scratch, declared12136B/thread private LCS arrays, CPU sort/transfers/representative control; no hardware counter evidence for bottlenecks.

RQ5.selection: All frontends express the named corrected sequencing-read component. KA native local-memory/barrier API suffices; current JACC faithful no-copy scratch mapping is CUDA-backend dependent. Source scientific inventories must be validated before biological or performance interpretation.
